nodes.label: Integrated Empirical Testing and Validation Chapter
nodes.norm_label: integrated empirical testing and validation chapter
nodes.rationale: Mengintegrasikan desain teoritis arsitektur Skillbridge AI dengan hasil evaluasi empiris benchmark 27 run, audit keamanan, dan tangkapan layar antarmuka produksi.

nodes.label: Closed-Loop Adaptive Learning Cycle
nodes.rationale: Membentuk siklus pembelajaran tertutup berkelanjutan: evaluasi bukti nyata -> analisis kesenjangan skill -> rekomendasi belajar RAG -> unggah bukti progres baru / wawancara simulasi -> evaluasi ulang.

nodes.label: Evidence Parser Architecture Component
nodes.rationale: Mengurai teks PDF/DOCX, visi multimodal portofolio visual, dan metadata GitHub REST API secara aman tanpa menjalankan kode pengguna untuk menghindari eksekusi kode berbahaya.

nodes.label: Adaptive Interview Simulator Architecture Component
nodes.rationale: Menghasilkan simulasi wawancara adaptif multi-turn yang menargetkan kelemahan spesifik pengguna dari hasil penilaian bukti nyata.

nodes.label: LLM Evaluation Engine Architecture Component
nodes.rationale: LLM mengevaluasi kriteria 0-100 dan mengutip bukti nyata yang ter-grounding, sedangkan agregasi skor akhir berbobot dihitung secara deterministik oleh server untuk transparansi dan auditabilitas.

nodes.label: RAG Recommendation Engine Architecture Component
nodes.rationale: Menggunakan embedding pencarian semantik pada basis modul terkurasi berdasarkan kesenjangan keterampilan (skill gaps) yang teridentifikasi untuk menghasilkan rekomendasi adaptif yang tepat sasaran.

nodes.label: Rubric Selector Architecture Component
nodes.rationale: Menyesuaikan rubrik penilaian kriteria terstruktur dan bobot berdasarkan bidang studi yang dipilih pengguna pada tahap orientasi.

nodes.label: Strict Supabase Database Migration Sequence
nodes.rationale: Migrations must be applied in strict 001-004 sequence; migration 003 provides quota consumption and atomic persistence RPCs

nodes.label: Untrusted Evidence and Server-Side Quote Grounding Policy
nodes.norm_label: untrusted evidence and server-side quote grounding policy
nodes.rationale: Treats user portfolios as untrusted input and rejects quotes that do not match referenced [PAGE:n:BLOCK:n] or [FILE:n:Lx-Ly] markers

nodes.label: Database RPC Quota and Atomic Assessment Storage
nodes.norm_label: database rpc quota and atomic assessment storage
nodes.rationale: Consumes daily API quota and stores assessment results atomically via PostgreSQL RPCs to prevent race conditions and partial states

nodes.label: Indirect Prompt Injection Defense Architecture
nodes.rationale: Isolates user submission data with explicit delimiters and strict system prompts to prevent adversarial instructions from manipulating evaluation

nodes.label: Marker-Grounded Quote Verification System
nodes.rationale: Validates that quotes cited by the model match source text within [PAGE:n:BLOCK:n] or [FILE:n:Lx-Ly] markers, rejecting ungrounded quotes

nodes.label: Security Hardening and Edge Case Validation
nodes.norm_label: security hardening and edge case validation
nodes.rationale: Validates system resilience against indirect prompt injection, quote hallucinations, Groq TPM 429 rate limits, and quota exhaustion

nodes.label: Security Remediation and Defense Hardening Architecture
nodes.norm_label: security remediation and defense hardening architecture
nodes.rationale: Establishes migration 003 RPCs, server-side quote verification, error sanitization, and upload boundary enforcement

nodes.label: Pre-Deploy Quality Gate (npm run check)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory gate executing lint, typecheck, tests, and build before any commit or production deployment

nodes.label: Automated NPM Security Updates
nodes.rationale: Automates daily dependency vulnerability checking and PR creation for npm packages to prevent bitrot and known exploits

nodes.label: Vercel Production Deployment Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Automates production build and release via npm run deploy, strictly gating on npm run check

nodes.label: CI Pipeline Full Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: Executes npm run check (lint, typecheck, tests, and build) on pull requests and pushes to main branch

nodes.label: NPM Audit High-Severity Vulnerability Gate
nodes.rationale: Runs npm audit with high-severity threshold in CI to fail builds and block vulnerable dependencies from production

nodes.label: Three-Stage Evidence Assessment User Journey
nodes.rationale: Three-stage workflow: Evidence Submission -> AI Assessment & Gap Breakdown -> Adaptive Technical Interview

nodes.label: Adaptive Technical Interview Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Conducts multi-turn conversational interview dynamically tailored to verify and probe candidate skill gaps

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Job Readiness Assessment
nodes.rationale: Evaluates candidate readiness through authentic work evidence rather than CV claims or GPA

nodes.label: Groq TPM Rate Limiting and Error Mapping
nodes.norm_label: groq tpm rate limiting and error mapping
nodes.rationale: Groq 8k TPM requires ~65s delay between evaluation requests and strict HTTP 429 ai_rate_limit mapping with Retry-After: 60

nodes.label: Groq Provider 8k TPM Governance
nodes.rationale: Enforces 65-second gap between AI calls to comply with Groq 8,000 TPM limit and translates provider 429 into HTTP 429 ai_rate_limit

nodes.label: Single-Stack Next.js 16 and React 19 Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single Next.js 16 + React 19 app with TypeScript and Tailwind v4 on Node 22; Supabase for auth/db/storage and Groq for LLM

nodes.label: Production Environment Variable Isolation
nodes.rationale: Safeguards secret keys (GROQ_API_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) from exposure by preventing NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixes and excluding .env files

nodes.label: Security Vulnerability Findings Matrix (SEC-001 to SEC-020)
nodes.norm_label: security vulnerability findings matrix (sec-001 to sec-020)
nodes.rationale: Classifies 20 security findings across High (rate limit, indirect injection, vision injection), Medium (upload buffers, PDF bomb, ungrounded quotes), and Low tiers

nodes.label: Core AI Assessment Boundary Principles
nodes.rationale: LLM assesses work evidence only; explicitly disclaims identity verification, candidate claim ownership, or hiring guarantees

nodes.label: Seven-Step Demonstration Flow
nodes.rationale: Structured narrative covering Problem (45s), Three Fields (30s), Consent (45s), Evaluation (60s), Gaps (45s), Interview (60s), and Reassessment (30s)

nodes.label: Ngrok Development Tunneling Protocol
nodes.rationale: Exposes local dev server for live demonstration while updating Supabase Auth redirect allowlist

nodes.label: End-to-End Latency and Groq Inference Cost Analysis
nodes.norm_label: end-to-end latency and groq inference cost analysis
nodes.rationale: Measures domain latencies (Informatika: 10.5s, DKV: 7.2s, Pemasaran: 12.8s) and confirms sub-cent cost per assessment ($0.001 - $0.003)

nodes.label: Metrik Latensi dan Efisiensi Biaya Provider Groq LPU
nodes.norm_label: metrik latensi dan efisiensi biaya provider groq lpu
nodes.rationale: Groq LPU API menghasilkan inferensi berkecepatan tinggi (~2.1-2.4 detik single-turn dan ~4.5 detik multi-stage visual) dengan biaya inferensi sangat rendah (~zsh.0004 per evaluasi), memungkinkan penerapan berskala besar di perguruan tinggi.

nodes.label: Groq JSON Object Mode Runtime Optimization
nodes.norm_label: groq json object mode runtime optimization
nodes.rationale: Strict json_schema dinonaktifkan dan diganti dengan response_format json_object yang dipadukan dengan validasi server-side Zod untuk menghindari eror json_validate_failed yang terjadi pada endpoint Groq.

nodes.label: Stabilitas dan Variansi Penilaian AI Lintas Bidang
nodes.norm_label: stabilitas dan variansi penilaian ai lintas bidang
nodes.rationale: Informatika mencapai determinisme sempurna (SD 0.0) karena evaluasi berbasis kode konkret dan git history; DKV memiliki sedikit fluktuasi (SD 3.46-4.62) karena penalaran visual LLM; Pemasaran stabil (SD 0.0-3.46) dengan ekstraksi teks terisolasi.

nodes.label: Cross-Domain Evidence Grounding & SHA256 Verification
nodes.rationale: Menyajikan verifikasi visual 9 sampel bukti fisik (kode, visual DKV, dokumen PDF) dengan status kelengkapan kriteria dan hash SHA256 untuk membuktikan AI benar-benar membuka dan memeriksa artefak.

nodes.label: Safe Null Score Propagation Demonstration
nodes.rationale: Membuktikan secara empiris bahwa sampel dengan bukti tidak mencukupi menghasilkan skor null (—/100) dan tidak dipaksakan menjadi angka nol atau halusinasi.

nodes.label: Multi-Domain Model Variance Analysis
nodes.rationale: Menunjukkan konsistensi skor penilaian pada 3 kali pengujian independen di mana Informatika deterministik 100% (SD 0.0), DKV SD 3.46-4.62, dan Pemasaran SD 0.0-3.46.

nodes.label: Event Board Ephemeral Storage Design
nodes.rationale: Data disimpan sementara dalam memori dan hilang saat server dimulai ulang untuk menyederhanakan prototipe papan acara kampus tanpa dependensi database eksternal.

nodes.label: Inventory Separation of Domain, Validation, and HTTP Structure
nodes.norm_label: inventory separation of domain, validation, and http structure
nodes.rationale: Domain inventori, validasi, dan penanganan rute HTTP sengaja dipisahkan secara modular untuk memfasilitasi pengujian unit, sementara penyimpanan in-memory dipilih untuk menjaga latihan tetap portabel.

nodes.label: Search Channel Budget Reallocation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Kanal Search menghasilkan conversion rate lebih tinggi (9,0% vs 6,0% Instagram), sehingga anggaran periode berikutnya diprioritaskan ke Search meskipun metrik biaya dan baseline tidak tersedia.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Funnel Messaging Strategy
nodes.rationale: Hipotesis pengujian menyatakan pesan berbasis bukti kerja meningkatkan CVR dan menekan CPA menjadi Rp50.000, dengan saluran Search dipertahankan untuk niat beli tinggi dan Instagram diuji ulang dengan kreatif baru.

nodes.label: Unsubstantiated Qualitative Reporting
nodes.rationale: Klaim keberhasilan kampanye hanya dinyatakan secara kualitatif tanpa angka impresi, klik, baseline, atau konversi terukur, sengaja memicu status insufficient_evidence pada evaluasi otomatis.

nodes.label: Discrete Score Anchors (0/25/50/75/100)
nodes.rationale: Restricts criterion scores to 5 discrete anchors plus null for insufficient evidence; application computes final score to prevent hallucinated scores

nodes.label: Interim Synthetic R1/R2 Human Simulation
nodes.rationale: Simulates human raters using LLM prompts to validate testing pipelines while explicitly noting non-fulfillment of Phase 1 human exit criteria

nodes.label: Phase 0 - Scope and Demo Artifact Freeze
nodes.norm_label: phase 0 - scope and demo artifact freeze
nodes.rationale: Locks 3 roles, 9 synthetic fixtures, SHA-256 manifest, and 5-7 minute demo script before code development

nodes.label: Phase 1 - Independent Human Ground Truth Baseline
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 - independent human ground truth baseline
nodes.rationale: Mandates double-blind scoring by two human raters R1/R2 with adjudication to establish authoritative ground truth

nodes.label: Phase 2 - Model Benchmark and Rubric 1.1 Hardening
nodes.norm_label: phase 2 - model benchmark and rubric 1.1 hardening
nodes.rationale: Executes 27 benchmark runs across 9 fixtures to verify stability, monotonic score progression, and schema validity

nodes.label: Phase 3 - End-to-End Product Prototype
nodes.rationale: Develops full web application with evidence upload, assessment results, gap-to-curriculum mapping, and adaptive interview

nodes.label: Nine Standardized Synthetic Portfolios
nodes.rationale: Provides calibrated weak, medium, and strong portfolios across 3 tracks, frozen under fixtures/manifest.sha256

nodes.label: Rubric 1.1 Criteria for Junior Web Developer
nodes.norm_label: rubric 1.1 criteria for junior web developer
nodes.rationale: Defines 4 weighted evaluation criteria: Code Organization (25%), Core Functionality (35%), Error Handling (20%), and Documentation/Git (20%)

nodes.label: Three-Run Informatics Stability and Sufficiency Evaluation
nodes.norm_label: three-run informatics stability and sufficiency evaluation
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates 0 variance in scores across 3 runs on INF-01 (0/100), INF-02 (50/100), and INF-03 (75/100) with 100% sufficiency consistency

nodes.label: Production Verification Across Three Domains
nodes.rationale: Confirms live deployment functionality on Vercel by executing end-to-end tests for Informatika (GitHub), DKV (Image), and Pemasaran (PDF)

nodes.label: Curated Learning Resource Pathways
nodes.rationale: Directly maps specific rubric skill gaps to authoritative external documentation (MDN, Next.js, GitHub docs) rather than generic courses

nodes.label: Three Entry-Level Job Roles Matrix
nodes.rationale: Defines accepted evidence modalities: Junior Web Developer (GitHub), Junior Graphic Designer (PNG/JPG + process), Junior Digital Marketer (PDF)

nodes.label: Double-Blind Scoring and Adjudication Protocol
nodes.rationale: Requires independent scoring using discrete anchors (0/25/50/75/100/null); triggers human adjudication when score delta >= 25 or sufficiency differs

nodes.label: Three Entry-Level Specialization Tracks
nodes.rationale: Provides tailored rubrics for Junior Web Developer, Junior Graphic Designer, and Junior Digital Marketer

nodes.label: Comprehensive 27-Run AI Model Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Full evaluation of 9 fixtures across 3 runs confirming 100% schema compliance, monotonic score tiers, and 0 variance across runs

nodes.label: Phase 1 Human Rater Blocking Dependency
nodes.rationale: Enforces strict protocol rule that Phase 1 cannot pass until real human raters R1/R2 complete independent scoring
